source_audits.finding: A previously certified handoff became stale after a material test commit; evidence was later rebound to the current material head.
The refreshed handoff declared previous_independent_rejection=false and omitted audit-escape-closure.json and learning-closure.json despite carrying evidence of the prior independent rejection.

rules: previous independent rejection requires escape and learning closures before handoff
terminal handoff must be a direct result-only child of the material head
universal post-write identity reconciliation prevents stale certificates

HANDOFF-HISTORY-001.procedure: Cross-check independent-rejection evidence against the certificate flag, mandatory closures and inherited controls.
HANDOFF-HISTORY-001.observed: The remediation sets previous_independent_rejection=true and materializes both required closures plus cumulative inherited controls.

HANDOFF-TERMINAL-001.procedure: Exercise generic terminal handoff parent/allowlist guards before publication; run the exact remote terminal gate again after publication.
HANDOFF-TERMINAL-001.observed: Generic terminal-handoff contract tests pass; exact remote validation is the final publication gate.
